mobile_390px_behaviour.tap_target_sizes: All interactive targets (inputs, selects, buttons, checkboxes) minimum 48px height or 44x44px bounding box
mobile_390px_behaviour.column_stacking: All 2-column form grids stack seamlessly into 1 column with 14px gap
mobile_390px_behaviour.identity_line: Kept cleanly wrapped at the very top, font-size 12px, brokerage name wrapping naturally without horizontal overflow
mobile_390px_behaviour.above_the_fold_priority: Mobile viewport shows IdentityLine → Eyebrow → H1 → Subhead → First field (Property Address) immediately accessible with zero scroll fatigue

accessibility_and_wcag.keyboard_navigation: Logical tab order: Address -> City -> Property Type -> Name -> Email -> Phone -> Timeline -> Listed Checkbox -> PIPA Checkbox -> CASL Checkbox -> Submit
accessibility_and_wcag.screen_readers: All form labels tied to inputs; error announcements have role='alert'; Article 16 block announced immediately upon reveal.

instructions_to_main_agent: Preserve 100% of existing functional logic, analytical tracking calls (trackFormView, trackThankYouView, trackStepComplete, trackFormStart, trackFormSubmit, trackArticle16Block, trackConversion, trackFieldError), and legal compliance.
Do NOT alter or shorten any legal wording for Doug LeMaire, REALTOR®, Fraser Property Management Realty Services Ltd. (BCFSA #167790), PIPA acknowledgement, or Article 16 notice.

Update the CSS in /app/frontend/src/index.css under the `.apple-form` section to incorporate the specified Apple spacing, 24px paper radius, 48px input height, refined typography, and squircle card shadows.

Structure the form JSX into 3 clear segmented sections separated by subtle hairline borders (`border-t border-black/[0.06] pt-6 mt-6`) with quiet uppercase step numbers (`01 · PROPERTY DETAILS`, `02 · CONTACT DETAILS`, `03 · VERIFICATION & SUBMISSION`).
Ensure the hero header is clean, modern, and aligned with Apple's calm editorial style: gentle eyebrow badge, Sora H1, and lead sentence.
Style the Article 16 alert as an Apple-level warm amber callout card rather than a harsh default alert, while maintaining the disabled state on the primary button.
Elevate the progressive disclosure accordion below the form into a glass-tinted summary box with smooth arrow rotation and elegant glossary term linking.
Verify mobile responsiveness at 390px (iPhone viewport) to ensure zero horizontal scroll, effortless thumb taps, and 16px input font size.
